capabilities.label: Target Resolution
capabilities.description: Scenario lookup and repository readability for security validation.

levels.name: No security target
levels.description: The target scenario cannot be resolved or scanned as a repository scenario.
levels.capability_summary: Security Health has no readable scenario target.
levels.next_unlock: A scenario directory that exists under scenarios/ and can be inspected.

levels.name: Target readable
levels.description: The target scenario resolves to a readable source tree.
levels.capability_summary: Security Health can inspect the target scenario.

levels.name: Target resolved
levels.description: The target scenario is resolved and ready for substrate and scanner checks.
levels.capability_summary: The security validation target is resolved and readable.

capabilities.label: Substrate Coverage
capabilities.description: Detection of supported and unsupported language/package substrates.

levels.name: Substrate unknown
levels.description: Security Health cannot classify the target scenario's security-relevant substrates.
levels.next_unlock: Readable source layout and dependency metadata.

levels.name: Substrates classified
levels.description: Go, pnpm, and unsupported substrates are represented in the validation report.
levels.next_unlock: Unsupported substrates are explicitly understood as advisory coverage gaps.

levels.name: Coverage gaps explicit
levels.description: Unsupported substrates are explicit and do not hide scanner blind spots.
levels.capability_summary: Substrate coverage gaps are visible and bounded.

levels.name: Substrate coverage clean
levels.description: No unsupported substrate findings remain for the target scenario.
levels.capability_summary: Supported security substrates are fully covered.

capabilities.label: Scanner Coverage
capabilities.description: Applicable security scanners are installed, runnable, and producing parseable output.

levels.name: Scanner context unavailable
levels.description: Security Health cannot determine scanner availability for applicable substrates.
levels.next_unlock: Applicable scanner binaries are discoverable or explicitly absent.

levels.name: Scanner context known
levels.description: Applicable scanner classes are known and absent scanners are reported explicitly.

levels.name: Scanners available
levels.description: Applicable scanner binaries are installed and can be invoked.
levels.capability_summary: Security scanners are available for applicable substrates.

levels.name: Scanners complete
levels.description: Applicable scanners complete and produce parseable findings or clean results.
levels.capability_summary: Scanner coverage is complete for the target scenario.

capabilities.label: Security Findings
capabilities.description: Secret exposure, SAST, reachable vulnerability, and dependency vulnerability findings emitted by scanners.

levels.name: Security findings unavailable
levels.description: Scanner findings cannot be evaluated for the target scenario.
levels.next_unlock: Scanner findings are normalized into the shared security report.

levels.name: Findings normalized
levels.description: Scanner findings are normalized with severity, location, and remediation.
levels.capability_summary: Security findings are visible and actionable.
levels.next_unlock: No ERROR-class secret, SAST, reachable vulnerability, or production dependency vulnerability remains.

levels.name: Safety blockers absent
levels.description: No scanner reports an ERROR-class secret, SAST, reachable vulnerability, or production dependency vulnerability.

levels.name: Security posture clean
levels.description: Scanner findings and advisory dependency intelligence are clean enough for continuous fleet posture monitoring.
levels.capability_summary: Security findings are clean for continuous fleet monitoring.
